releases.title: MVR export and 3D in its own window

items.title: Export stage and fixtures
items.text: Library → Export MVR scene… writes fixtures with their patch and the 3D stage as an .mvr file for Vectorworks, Capture or Depence.

items.title: 3D in its own window
items.text: On request the 3D simulation runs in a window of its own with its own process – ideal for a second screen. The console stays smooth.

items.title: Calm editor
items.text: In Build and Fixtures mode the fixtures are dark (red in Fixtures mode) and the room light is even – building stays smooth.

items.title: Saves power when nothing is visible
items.text: A minimized or covered window stops drawing 3D; when the picture rests it becomes sharper.

items.title: VR button only on VR devices
items.text: The VR button only appears where it is useful. New settings in Room & light.

items.title: Guides updated
items.text: The guides 3D Simulation and Fixtures describe the new functions – the assistant knows them too.

releases.title: MVR import and a faster 3D simulation

items.title: Import a stage from your design software
items.text: Library → Import MVR scene… brings in the stage and the fixtures from Vectorworks, Capture or Depence: patched, placed and ready to light.

items.title: File manager with groups
items.text: The lists have a List | Groups switch, and “Delete unused” cleans up 3D models that no stage uses.

items.title: Switch the 3D simulation off
items.text: A pause button stops the 3D simulation completely, so nothing slows down the rest of the console.

items.title: Room & light as a dialog
items.text: Settings for all devices and for this device only, with options for very big stages (cones, shadows, frame rate).

items.title: Fixes for big shows
items.text: No more freezing after loading a show with many fixtures, light cones that point out of the lenses and moving heads that move in 3D.

items.title: New guide: 3D Simulation
items.text: Buttons, settings and a troubleshooting list - the AI assistant can use it too.

items.title: Save as a Markdown file
items.text: Save any chat or note as a Markdown file with one click.

items.title: In backups and show packages
items.text: “Back up everything” now includes your chats and notes, and “Export show” can add them to the package.

items.title: REST API for chats and notes
items.text: Scripts and hardware can read and write chats and notes through the REST API.

items.title: Immediate start
items.text: OpenCue no longer pauses at start while an old one is still closing: the start screen appears at once, and the message tells you what to do.

items.title: Release notes, nicely formatted
items.text: The update window now shows the release notes with headings and lists instead of plain text.

items.title: A proper “What’s new” window
items.text: After an update, this window lists the new features of every version you skipped – in your language.

items.title: Wider settings search
items.text: The search in the settings is wider and its suggestions are no longer cut off.

items.title: Chat & Notes panel
items.text: Chat between the console, iPads and phones – with “is typing” – plus notes and checklists in Markdown, saved on the server.

items.title: Fixes
items.text: Long sub-menus scroll instead of being cut off, and password fields show dots again.

items.title: A new DMX core
items.text: Output, effects and cue fades run in their own process – a steady 40 frames per second even under heavy load.

items.title: DMX input
items.text: Receive Art-Net and sACN from another desk, forward and merge it, or use channels as triggers.

items.title: Remote control that can do everything
items.text: A tablet has the same rights as the console, including all settings.

items.title: Control from outside
items.text: MIDI, OSC, a REST API, custom keyboard shortcuts, a scheduler and offline voice control.

items.title: Timeline and timecode
items.text: A timeline editor with waveforms, LTC in and out, MIDI timecode.

items.title: Your own fixtures
items.text: A fixture editor, GDTF Share preview and CSV / Excel patch import.

items.title: Safe shows
items.text: Background backups with crash recovery, global undo and a show lock.

items.title: Six languages
items.text: German, English, French, Dutch, Italian and Spanish – including the guides.
